name: DUMBBELL DECLINE FLOOR PRESS
introduce:
Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Hold a dumbbell in each hand.

Raise your arms towards the ceiling with your palms facing forward and your elbows slightly bent. Lift your hips off the floor until your knees are at 90 degrees.

Lower the dumbbells out to the sides until your upper arms touch the floor. Return and repeat.

tips.text: Keep your core tight and back straight.
Exhale as you raise the dumbbells, and inhale as you lower them.
You should feel your chest engage.
This exercise works your chest muscles.
